patch_description:
I analyzed the performance metrics of the previous candidates and identified that the high-performing model (1.52 score) relied on a clean, hardware-efficient architecture using parametrized ring entanglers. The current candidate's lower performance was likely due to an overly complex entanglement layer (extra fixed CZ gates) that increased depth and disrupted the effective parameter learning. 

I have reverted to a refined version of the high-performing structure. By using `CRY` (parameterized rotation in Y) instead of `CRX`, I provide more relevant entanglement for the binary classifier, as the feature map uses `IsingZZ` couplings which are inherently Z-basis rotations. This design maintains the optimal parameter count (24 per block, 146 total), ensures strong connectivity via the ring topology, and minimizes circuit depth to accelerate training convergence and reduce overfitting.
